meta.title: Work with us
meta.description: We are looking for cleaners across Västra Götaland, Jönköping and Halland. Proper employment, the same team and paid travel time.

title: Work with us
lead: We are growing and looking for people who like finishing a job properly. You do not need experience of cleaning, but you do need to arrive on time and do what you said you would.
offer: Proper employment, not work invoiced afterwards
The same customers regularly, so you are not starting over every day
An introduction before your first shift, even if you are new to this
wanted: Speak Swedish or English, so we can agree things with the customer
Are thorough even when nobody is checking
Have a driving licence, which helps but is not required
formText: Fill in the form and we will be in touch if we have something that fits. We read every application.
name: Name
cityHelp: Where do you live? We plan routes around where staff are.
message: Tell us a little about yourself
messageHelp: Previous experience, when you could start, how much you want to work.
cvHelp: PDF or Word, up to 5 MB.
consent: I agree that MA Städ may contact me about this application.
consentHelp: We keep the application for twelve months and never pass it on.
successText: We will read it through and be in touch if we have something that fits. It can take a week or so.
